Scene: @UUID[Compendium.points-of-interest.scenes.Scene.VgRuna04QJl2xYGX]{04. The Gardeners}

Actors: @UUID[Compendium.points-of-interest.actors.Actor.xF6dMsBD9BzUTEf0]{Matriarch Gorm}, @UUID[Compendium.points-of-interest.actors.Actor.Auqitp5dFPpwo31C]{Rorrik}, @UUID[Compendium.points-of-interest.actors.Actor.HIQlOLAzIK38bo0j]{Thud}, @UUID[Compendium.points-of-interest.actors.Actor.TAjCA6fNVtrcIDTm]{Snip}, @UUID[Compendium.points-of-interest.actors.Actor.Y9HDxJ7AkesW6q7q]{Mulch}, @UUID[Compendium.points-of-interest.actors.Actor.D2D3uk2B2c4PJ9FQ]{Bramble}, @UUID[Compendium.points-of-interest.actors.Actor.mYsgkF5GLDSVbmSH]{Captain Mira Vell}, @UUID[Compendium.points-of-interest.actors.Actor.EVSte9Sl44zBWH7T]{Haddo}, @UUID[Compendium.points-of-interest.actors.Actor.GY0gMM6XZ5GRsXao]{Ysolde}, @UUID[Compendium.points-of-interest.actors.Actor.DGqCp4VjAY6gR7m6]{Brother Amat}, @UUID[Compendium.points-of-interest.actors.Actor.jpRqDvbDdVIfU7fJ]{Tobin}

Zone Zone 14: Glenebon Lowlands (a ruined noble estate)
Hex 8.5 on the Stolen Lands map
Type Combat with a rescue
Threat Moderate (90 XP) at party level 16
Creatures 6 elite athaches (level 13, Pathfinder Bestiary 2)

Irovetti's map note. The outline of a manor with formal hedges, and three small upright figures drawn between them. Beneath: "Varrold estate — reclaim after the war. Statues??"

Background. House Varrold held this estate until the family fell from Irovetti's favour. A family of athaches moved into the overgrown gardens and made them a larder. Their venom leaves victims enfeebled and helpless, and they stand those victims among the hedges as "statues", fed just enough water to live. The athaches call themselves gardeners and tend their collection with grotesque care. Five travellers still live, propped in the hedges.

Arrival.

A manor's roofless shell stands behind formal gardens gone wild. Between the clipped hedges, figures stand on plinths like statuary: a farmer, a pedlar, a woman in a Pitaxian officer's coat. One of them turns her eyes to follow you. From the topiary maze comes the sound of shears and a voice humming, as deep as falling rock.

Features.

  • Topiary maze. Hedges 15 feet high form corridors 15 feet wide. Hedges are difficult terrain to push through (DC 30 Athletics to Force Open a gap) and block line of sight. The athaches know every gap and move through them at full speed.
  • The plinths. Five living victims, each enfeebled 3 and unable to act. An athach adjacent to a victim can use an action to grab one as a shield (the victim takes damage meant for the athach on a critical hit).
  • Compost heap. A pit of rotting mulch and bones. A creature that falls in is slowed 1 for 1 round from the stench (DC 32 Fortitude negates).
  • Ruined manor. Collapsed upper floor; rubble provides standard cover. The athaches throw chunks of masonry from it.

Running the encounter. The athaches fight as a family with roles.

  • Matriarch Gorm and her mate hold the manor rubble and use Throw Rock from cover.
  • Four adolescents work the maze in pairs, flanking and using fist-fist-Swift Claw combinations to apply Athach Venom.
  • Hostages. When an athach drops below half HP, its next action grabs the nearest victim and threatens to bite. A PC can Demoralize (DC 31) or Feint to make it drop the victim. A bitten victim dies.
  • Rescue clock. Each victim needs a DC 32 Medicine check or a cure for poison to recover enough to walk. Moving the victims out of the maze takes time; an athach that sees a victim being carried away bellows, and every athach moves to stop the theft.

Outcomes.

  • All athaches dead, all victims alive. The ideal ending; the PCs gain grateful witnesses.
  • Victims lost. Count the dead; Captain Mira Vell, the Pitaxian officer, is the most valuable survivor (below).
  • Athaches flee. Any surviving adolescents run to the Glenebon Uplands and join the six-athach band of the Zone 16 table.

Rewards. 90 XP; +10 XP for each living victim rescued. Treasure: the Varrold family silver and a hidden strongbox (1,600 gp total), a +2 greater striking polearm from a dead knight, and a level 16 permanent item among the athaches' trophies. Kingdom: Captain Mira Vell of the Pitax army owes the PCs her life and can serve as an army commander or informant during the war; once Pitax falls, she can help secure the estate as a new settlement site.

Scaling. Use four athaches for a Low threat. At party level 18, use six elite athaches and give Gorm the elite adjustment twice (level 14).
